turns.question: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that got a reply, what was the 75th percentile of hours between the message and the reply?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the hours between an outreach message and its reply, so it cannot give a 75th percentile. The closest metrics are messages_replied (outreach messages that got a reply, counted on the day sent) and reply_rate (the share of messages sent that got a reply).
